locations.name: Slayer Tower
travel: Fairy ring CKS to Canifis, then run north-west.
Kharyrll Teleport (Ancient Magicks) to Canifis.
Slayer ring teleport directly to the tower.
Ectophial to Port Phasmatys, then run west.

locations.name: Stronghold Slayer Cave
travel: Spirit tree or gnome glider to the Grand Tree, then run south to Nieve.
Slayer ring teleport to the Stronghold Slayer Cave.
Necklace of passage to the Outpost, then run west.
Tree Gnome Stronghold balloon or teleport seed.

locations.name: Catacombs of Kourend
travel: Kourend Castle teleport, then use the statue to enter the catacombs.
Xeric's talisman to Xeric's Heart, then run to the castle statue.
Kourend portal in a player-owned house.
Games necklace to Wintertodt and run south if you lack Kourend teleports.

locations.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
travel: Fairy ring AJR, then enter the cave to the east.
Slayer ring teleport to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon.
Enchanted lyre or Rellekka teleport, then run south-east.
House teleport to Rellekka if your house is there.

locations.name: Brimhaven Dungeon
travel: Teleport to Brimhaven (house, cart, or Karamja gloves) and pay 875 coins to enter.
Amulet of glory to Karamja, then run west to Brimhaven.
Charter ship to Brimhaven.
Bring an axe and 875 coins (or Karamja gloves 3+ for free entry).

locations.name: Taverley Dungeon
travel: Games necklace to Burthorpe, then run south to Taverley.
Teleport to Falador and run north-west.
House teleport to Taverley.
Bring a dusty key or 70 Agility to skip the long route.

locations.name: Edgeville Dungeon
travel: Amulet of glory to Edgeville, then climb down the trapdoor.
Paddewwa Teleport (Ancient Magicks) into the dungeon.
Varrock teleport and run north-west to Edgeville.

locations.name: Abyssal Area
travel: Fairy ring ALR after Fairytale II — Cure a Queen.
Abyssal Sire is through the inner passage; regular demons are in the area.

locations.name: Kraken Cove
travel: Piscatoris teleport (amulet of glory alternative: fairy ring AKQ) and run south-west.
Western banner or Piscatoris tablet, then run to the cove.
Eagle transport to Piscatoris if unlocked.

locations.name: Mount Karuulm
travel: Fairy ring CIR, then run north to Konar and the dungeon lift.
Rada's blessing teleport to Mount Karuulm.
Xeric's talisman to Xeric's Inferno, then run north.
Requires boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots inside the dungeon.

locations.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
travel: Fairy ring CIR to Mount Karuulm, then use the lift down.
Wear boots of stone, brimstone, or granite to avoid heavy damage.
Rada's blessing 3+ teleport to the mountain.

locations.name: Chasm of Fire
travel: Fairy ring DJR, then enter the chasm.
Xeric's talisman to Xeric's Heart and run west.
Kourend Castle teleport and run west past Shayzien.

locations.name: God Wars Dungeon
travel: Trollheim teleport (83 Magic, Eadgar's Ruse) and run north to the hole.
Stony basalt or teleport to Troll Stronghold, then run north.
GWD minigame teleport if purchased.
Bring a rope the first time, 60 Strength or 60 Agility, and god items.

locations.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
travel: Burning amulet to the Bandit Camp or Graveyard, then run to the cave.
Games necklace to Corporeal Beast and run north-west.
Obelisks or Wilderness sword, then run to the cave in mid-level Wilderness.

locations.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
travel: Teleport crystal to Prifddinas, then enter the Iorwerth dungeon in the south-west.
Spirit tree to Prifddinas after Song of the Elves.
Eternal teleport crystal for a closer landing.

locations.name: Smoke Devil Dungeon
travel: Fairy ring BKP, then run south to the dungeon.
Castle Wars teleport (dueling ring) and run south.
Watch out for the Thermonuclear smoke devil boss room deeper in.

locations.name: Kalphite Lair
travel: Desert amulet 4 to the Kalphite Cave, or run west of Shantay Pass.
Fairy ring BIQ and run north-west.
Bring two ropes the first time you enter the lair.
Shantay Pass from a ring of dueling to Al Kharid, then run south-west.

locations.name: Kalphite Cave
travel: Desert amulet 2+ to Nardah, then run north-west.
Magic carpet to Shantay Pass and run east of the lair.
This cave is the usual Kalphite task spot (not the Queen lair).

locations.name: Lumbridge Swamp Caves
travel: Lumbridge teleport and run south-west into the swamp cave.
Fairy ring AJQ lands inside the caves (requires quests).
Bring a light source and rope. A slayer helmet covers wall beasts.

locations.name: Mos Le'Harmless Cave
travel: Mos Le'Harmless island teleport after Cabin Fever, then enter the cave.
Charter ship to Mos Le'Harmless.
Bring a witchwood icon and a light source for cave horrors.

locations.name: Wyvern Cave
travel: Digsite pendant to Fossil Island, then sail to the museum camp and enter the cave.
Bird house run teleport, then run to the wyvern entrance.
Bring an elemental, mind, or ancient wyvern shield.

locations.name: Stronghold of Security
travel: Amulet of glory to Edgeville, then enter the Stronghold in Barbarian Village.
Skull sceptre teleport to Barbarian Village.
Varrock teleport and run west.

locations.name: Waterfall Dungeon
travel: Games necklace to Barbarian Outpost, then run south to the waterfall.
Teleport to Ardougne and run north.
Board the log and enter the dungeon behind the waterfall (Waterfall Quest).

locations.name: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon
travel: Falador teleport and run south to the dungeon on Ice Mountain's coast.
Port Sarim via explorer's ring or house, then run west.
Skeletal wyverns are at the back of the dungeon.

locations.name: Smoke Dungeon
travel: Pollnivneach teleport or magic carpet, then enter the well to the west.
Fairy ring DLQ and run west to Pollnivneach.
Wear a face mask, slayer helmet, or gas mask.
Requires the start of Desert Treasure I.

locations.name: Waterbirth Island
travel: Waterbirth island teleport (scroll or house) or enchanted lyre.
Rellekka dock — talk to Jarvald.
Dagannoth Kings require the lighthouse path or a pet rock / 2+ team.

locations.name: Lletya
travel: Teleport crystal to Lletya after Starting Underground Pass / Regicide.
Overpass of Tirannwn from Isafdar.

locations.name: Prifddinas
travel: Teleport crystal or spirit tree to Prifddinas.
Eternal teleport crystal for a closer landing.
Requires Song of the Elves.

locations.name: Mor Ul Rek
travel: Fire cape to enter Mor Ul Rek, or the TzHaar city outer area via the volcano.
Amulet of glory to Karamja, then run to the volcano.
Fairy ring DIR then run to the cave (TzHaar).

locations.name: Corsair Cove Dungeon
travel: Corsair Cove teleport via the spirit tree after The Corsair Curse.
Pirates' hook / dragon defender? Use the spirit tree on the island.
Enter the dungeon in the south of the cove.

locations.name: Ogre Enclave
travel: Castle Wars (dueling ring) and run south to Gu'Tanoth.
Fairy ring AKS, then run west.
Requires Watchtower quest access to the enclave.

locations.name: Heroes' Guild
travel: Burthorpe games necklace, then run south-east to the Heroes' Guild.
Requires Heroes' Quest. Blue dragons are in the basement.

locations.name: Brine Rat Cavern
travel: Enchanted lyre or Rellekka house teleport, then run east to the rock.
Use a spade on the small rock north-east of Rellekka (Olaf's Quest).
Fairy ring DKS and run west.

locations.name: Braindeath Island
travel: Talk to Pirate Pete north of Port Phasmatys after Rum Deal.
Ectophial, then run north to Pirate Pete's boat.
Fever spiders are in the brewery basement. Wear slayer gloves.

locations.name: Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon
travel: Dorgesh-Kaan sphere after Death to the Dorgeshuun, then go south.
Lumbridge cellar to Dorgesh-Kaan.
Bring a light source.

locations.name: Bandit Camp
travel: Burning amulet teleport to the Bandit Camp.
Amulet of glory to Edgeville, then run north into the Wilderness.
Revenant cave exit and run south-west.

locations.name: Chaos Temple
travel: Burning amulet to the Chaos Temple.
Edgeville, then run north-east.
Ice plateau or obelisks, then run south.

locations.name: The Forgotten Cemetery
travel: Burning amulet to Bandit Camp, then run north-west.
Games necklace to Corporeal Beast and run west.
Ankou roam the cemetery in mid-level Wilderness.

locations.name: Deep Wilderness Dungeon
travel: Ghorrock teleport (Ancient Magicks) and run east.
Wilderness obelisk to level 44+, then run to the dungeon.
Ice plateau teleport (lunar) and run south-east.

locations.name: Revenant Caves
travel: Revenant cave entrance north of the Graveyard of Shadows.
Burning amulet to Bandit Camp, then run north-east.
Games necklace to Corp and run north.
Bring a charged bracelet of ethereum.

locations.name: Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness)
travel: Paddewwa teleport or Edgeville trapdoor, then run north past the Wilderness gate.
Earth warriors live in the wildy section of Edgeville Dungeon.

locations.name: Lizardman Canyon
travel: Xeric's talisman to Xeric's Lookout, then run west.
Fairy ring DJR and run east.
Shayzien teleport via Xeric's talisman and run south.
Wear a Shayzien helm (5) to avoid lizardman shaman poison sprays.

locations.name: Lizardman Settlement
travel: Xeric's talisman to Xeric's Inferno, then run south.
Battlefront teleport (ancient) and run west.
Fairy ring CIR and run south.

locations.name: Meiyerditch Laboratories
travel: Drakan's medallion to Meiyerditch, then enter the laboratories.
Requires Sins of the Father progress.
Mutated bloodvelds are the usual task here.

locations.name: Ancient Cavern
travel: Games necklace to Barbarian Outpost, then jump the whirlpool south of Baxtorian Falls.
Requires Barbarian Training — Firemaking.
Mithril dragons and waterfiends are inside.

locations.name: Myths' Guild
travel: Myths' Guild cape teleport after Dragon Slayer II.
Spirit tree to Corsair Cove and run south-west? Use the guild cape.
Red dragons and adamant/rune dragons are in the basement.

locations.name: Isle of Souls
travel: Soul Wars portal from Edgeville or Ferox Enclave.
Minigame grouping teleport to Soul Wars.
Crabs and some dragons are on the island.

locations.name: Crabclaw Isle
travel: Xeric's talisman to Xeric's Glade, then pay 10,000 coins for the boat (or 1 with Hosidius elite).
Kourend Castle teleport and run south through Hosidius.
Sand crabs line the shores.

locations.name: Fossil Island
travel: Digsite pendant to Fossil Island.
Rub the pendant and choose the House on the Hill for mushroom-forest crabs.
Ammonite crabs are on the east beach.

locations.name: Rellekka east beach
travel: Enchanted lyre to Rellekka, then run east to the rock crabs.
Rellekka house teleport.
Fairy ring DKS and run west.

locations.name: Ruins of Tapoyauik
travel: Quetzal transport to Aldarin or the Tapoyauik landing, then enter the ruins.
Varlamore portal or pendant of ates, then fly a quetzal south-west.
Bring desert heat protection if travelling overland.

locations.name: Morytania Spider Cave
travel: Fairy ring CKS, then run south-east toward Burgh de Rott / the spider cave.
Drakan's medallion to Ver Sinhaza and run west.
Slayer ring to the tower and run south.
Araxxor is deeper in the cave.

locations.name: Ynysdail Cavern
travel: Sail to Ynysdail / The Great Conch (Sailing), then enter the cavern.
Requires 73 Sailing for Aquanites.
Mortimer is the usual master who assigns this.

locations.name: Wyrmscraig Cavern
travel: Sail to Wyrmscraig after Fallen From Grace, then enter Mortimer's cavern.
Mortimer assigns Venators and other superior-capable tasks here.

locations.name: Poison Waste Dungeon
travel: Teleport crystal to Lletya, then run south-west to the Poison Waste.
Requires The Path of Glouphrie for warped creatures.
Bring antipoison.

locations.name: Al Kharid
travel: Amulet of glory to Al Kharid.
Ring of dueling to the Emir's Arena, then run south.
Cows, scorpions, and desert lizards are nearby.

locations.name: Lumbridge
travel: Lumbridge teleport.
Home teleport on the standard spellbook.
Cows, goblins, rats, spiders, and birds surround the town.

locations.name: Falador cabbage patch / farm
travel: Explorer's ring cabbage-patch teleport.
Falador teleport and run south-east.
Cows and chickens (birds) are in the farm pens.

locations.name: Varrock Sewers
travel: Varrock teleport, then enter the sewers east of the palace or from the graveyard.
Moss giants, zombies, and skeletons live in the deeper tunnels.

locations.name: Edgeville Dungeon (Hill Giants)
travel: Glory to Edgeville, down the trapdoor, then run south to the giant rooms.
Brass key from the shed west of the Cooks' Guild for a shorter route.

locations.name: Lunar Isle
travel: Lunar Isle teleport after Lunar Diplomacy.
Seal of passage or Fremennik elite diary to dock.
Suqahs surround the island.

locations.name: Trollheim / Death Plateau
travel: Trollheim teleport (Eadgar's Ruse) or stony basalt.
Games necklace to Burthorpe, then climb Death Plateau.
Trolls occupy Death Plateau, Troll Stronghold, and Trollheim.

locations.name: Jiggig
travel: Castle Wars dueling-ring teleport, then run south.
Fairy ring AKS and run north.
Zogres/skogres (ogres) after Zogre Flesh Eaters.

locations.name: Karamja monkeys
travel: Amulet of glory to Karamja for mainland monkeys, or Ape Atoll teleport.
Gnome glider to Karamja.
Ape Atoll monkeys require Monkey Madness I.

locations.name: Sophanem Dungeon
travel: Pharaoh's sceptre to Jalsavrah / Sophanem.
Magic carpet to Sophanem after Contact!.
Scabarites fill the dungeon beneath the city.

locations.name: Mort'ton
travel: Morytania legs to Burgh de Rott, then run north.
Kharyrll teleport and run south through Mort Myre.
Shades spawn in Mort'ton and the Shade Catacombs.

locations.name: Miscellania and Etceteria Dungeon
travel: Fairy ring CIP to Miscellania, then enter the dungeon.
Ring of wealth to Miscellania.
Sea snakes after Royal Trouble.

locations.name: Killerwatt plane
travel: Go to Draynor Manor's top floor and use the energy portal (insulated boots required).
Glory to Draynor Village, then run north to the manor.
Requires Ernest the Chicken.

locations.name: Zanaris
travel: Lost City fairy ring ( Dramen or lunar staff in the shed south of Lumbridge).
Fairy ring BKS / Zanaris hub.
Otherworldly beings and cosmic rune area are in the city.

locations.name: Mudskipper Point
travel: Fairy ring AIQ, then use fishing explosives on the ogre.
Falador teleport and run south past Port Sarim.
Mogres only appear after using a fishing explosive.

locations.name: Kharidian Desert lizards
travel: Fairy ring DLQ, then run north to the lizards.
Nardah teleport (desert amulet) and run north-west.
Bring ice coolers to finish them.

locations.name: Tarn's Lair
travel: Slayer ring to Tarn's Lair.
Canifis (fairy ring CKS), through the basement of the hairdresser / Lair of Tarn Razorlor.
Terror dogs are near the end of the lair.

locations.name: Black Knights' Fortress
travel: Falador teleport and run north to the fortress.
Mind Altar teleport and run west.
Wilderness Black Knights also count for Krystilia.

locations.name: Lava Dragon Isle
travel: Burning amulet to the Lava Maze, then run south to the isle.
Ghorrock teleport and run south-east.
Protect from Magic and antifire. This is deep Wilderness.

locations.name: Magic Axe Hut
travel: Ghorrock teleport and run east to the locked hut (lockpick required).
Wilderness obelisk to level 50+, then run north-east.
Deep Wilderness — expect PKers.

locations.name: Dark Warriors' Fortress
travel: Burning amulet to Bandit Camp, then run south-west.
Edgeville and run north-west into the Wilderness.
Level 12-15 Wilderness.

locations.name: Ice Mountain
travel: Falador teleport and run north to Ice Mountain.
Mind Altar teleport.
Icefiends live on the mountain; ice warriors/giants are in the dungeon below.

locations.name: Frozen Waste Plateau
travel: Ice plateau teleport (lunar) or Ghorrock, then run west.
Deep Wilderness icefiends and ice giants.

locations.name: Weiss
travel: Icy basalt teleport to Weiss after Making Friends with My Arm.
Trollheim teleport and take the cave north.
Ice trolls count for troll tasks.

locations.name: Lighthouse
travel: Games necklace to Barbarian Outpost, then run north-west to the lighthouse.
Enchanted lyre and run south-west.
Dagannoth under the lighthouse after Horror from the Deep.

locations.name: Harpie bug swarm area
travel: Amulet of glory to Karamja, then run east along the coast.
Gnome glider to Karamja and run east.
A lit bug lantern is required to damage them.

locations.name: Mos Le'Harmless shores
travel: Charter ship or Cabin Fever island access, then fight along the shores.
Mos Le'Harmless cave entrance area also has jungle horrors.

locations.name: River Elid / Nardah
travel: Desert amulet to Nardah, then run north to the river.
Fairy ring DLQ and run south.
Crocodiles line the River Elid.

locations.name: Ghoul wall
travel: Fairy ring CKS to Canifis, then run west to the wall.
Kharyrll teleport.
Ghouls cluster outside the Mort Myre gate.

locations.name: Canifis
travel: Fairy ring CKS or Kharyrll teleport.
Werewolves in the village count while in human form if you have the ring, or wolf-form NPCs.
Priest in Peril required.

locations.name: Shadow Dungeon
travel: Ring of visibility (or equivalent) after Desert Treasure I, south of the Fishing Guild.
Skills necklace to the Fishing Guild, then run south into the dungeon.
Shadow warriors are inside.

locations.name: Sourhog Cave
travel: Varrock teleport and run south-west toward Draynor / the cave from A Porcine of Interest.
Draynor teleport (glory) and run north-east.
Spria assigns this after the quest.

locations.name: Champions' Guild
travel: Combat bracelet to the Champions' Guild.
Varrock teleport and run south-west.
Chickens and giant frogs nearby count for birds / similar low tasks.

locations.name: Dwarven Mine
travel: Falador teleport and run north-east to the mine entrance.
Mining guild (skills necklace) connects to the mine.
Dwarves fill the tunnels.

locations.name: Keldagrim
travel: Mine cart from the Grand Exchange or Dwarven Mine after Giant Dwarf.
Enchanted lyre and run east to the cave north of Rellekka.
Dwarves throughout the city.

locations.name: Ardougne Zoo
travel: Ardougne teleport and run east to the zoo.
Skills necklace to the Fishing Guild and run south.
Monkeys and other low-level creatures are in the cages / nearby.

locations.name: Feldip Hills
travel: Fairy ring AKS.
Castle Wars (dueling ring) and run south.
Ogres, wolves, and jungle creatures roam here.

locations.name: White Wolf Mountain
travel: Games necklace to Burthorpe, then run west over the mountain.
Taverley house teleport.
Wolves and bears on and around the mountain.

locations.name: Varrock
travel: Varrock teleport.
Chronicle to the Champions' Guild and run north.
Dogs, rats, bears in the zoo, and dark wizards south of the walls.

locations.name: Draynor Village
travel: Amulet of glory to Draynor Village.
Lumbridge teleport and run west.
Trees have birds; farms have cows; jail has pirates / skeletons nearby.

locations.name: Port Sarim
travel: Explorer's ring to the cabbage patch, then run south-west.
Falador teleport and run south.
Rats, thieves, and the Port Sarim jail pirates.

locations.name: Mos Le'Harmless
travel: Charter ship or quest access after Cabin Fever.
Pirates throughout the town count for pirate tasks.

locations.name: Brimhaven
travel: House teleport to Brimhaven or charter ship.
Glory to Karamja and run west.
Pirates, dogs, and the dungeon entrance.

locations.name: Karamja Volcano
travel: Amulet of glory to Karamja, then enter the volcano.
Lesser and greater demons inside the crater and TzHaar entrance.

locations.name: Crandor
travel: Karamja gloves to the gem mine, then run, or sail during Dragon Slayer I.
Lesser demons and skeletons on the island.
Requires Dragon Slayer I access.

locations.name: Giants' Den
travel: Xeric's talisman to Xeric's Shrine / Shayzien and run to the den.
Fire giants, hill giants, and moss giants share this cave.

locations.name: Ourania Cave / ZMI
travel: Ourania teleport (lunar) or run west of Ardougne.
ZMI cave has death paves of various monsters including some task extras.

locations.name: Gryphon hunting grounds
travel: Quetzal to Varlamore, then fly toward the Avium Savannah / coastal cliffs where gryphons nest.
Pendant of ates or Civitas teleport, then use quetzal transport.
Check the wiki for the latest nest locations.

locations.name: Frost dragon cavern
travel: Sail to the frost dragon cavern unlocked with Sailing content.
Bring antifire protection and a stab weapon.
Confirm the current landing with the OSRS Wiki if docks move.

locations.name: Custodian stalker ruins
travel: Quetzal transport across Varlamore to the ruined temples that house custodian stalkers.
Pendant of ates, then fly to the nearest landing.
Lesser nagua often share Varlamore temple interiors.

locations.name: Lesser nagua temples
travel: Varlamore quetzal network to the temple complexes.
Ruins of Tapoyauik also host related creatures.
Wear the recommended Varlamore temple protection from the wiki if listed.

locations.name: Ferox Enclave
travel: Ring of dueling to Ferox Enclave.
Safe hub for Wilderness slayer; many Krystilia spots are a short run north.
Restore stats at the pool before leaving.

locations.name: Corporeal Beast cave
travel: Games necklace to Corporeal Beast.
Used as a drop-off for Wilderness Slayer Cave and nearby green dragons.

locations.name: West green dragons
travel: Burning amulet to Chaos Temple, then run west.
Ferox Enclave and run north-west.
Classic green dragon spot in low-level Wilderness.

locations.name: East green dragons
travel: Burning amulet to Chaos Temple, then run east.
South of the Graveyard of Shadows.

locations.name: Red Dragon Isle
travel: Burning amulet to Lava Maze, then run south-east.
Deep Wilderness. Bring antifire and expect PKers.

locations.name: Taverley Dungeon (black dragons)
travel: Games necklace to Burthorpe, through Taverley Dungeon with a dusty key or 70 Agility.
Poison waste? No — Taverley Dungeon rear cavern.
Anti-dragon shield and antifire potions.

locations.name: Evil Chicken's Lair
travel: Zanaris (Dramen staff), use a raw chicken on the shrine, then enter.
Black dragons inside. Requires Recipe for Disaster progress / chicken.

locations.name: Lithkren Vault
travel: Digsite pendant to Lithkren after Dragon Slayer II.
Adamant and rune dragons; mithril dragons nearby in the vault area.
Bring antifire protection.

locations.name: Rune Dragon lair
travel: Digsite pendant to Lithkren after Dragon Slayer II.
Use the vault lift to the rune dragon chamber.
Extended super antifire and a stab weapon.

locations.name: Ungael (Vorkath)
travel: Talk to Gadrin in Rellekka after Dragon Slayer II, or use the portal at the Myths' Guild.
Counts as blue dragons if you choose to kill Vorkath.

locations.name: Abyssal Sire lair
travel: Fairy ring ALR, then enter the Sire chambers to the north.
Requires 85 Slayer. Counts for abyssal demons.

locations.name: Alchemical Hydra lair
travel: Fairy ring CIR, down the Karuulm lift, then through the hydra area to the boss.
Requires 95 Slayer and boots of stone/brimstone/granite.

locations.name: Kraken (boss)
travel: Enter Kraken Cove and go to the boss instance (requires 87 Slayer).
Piscatoris teleport then south-west to the cove.

locations.name: Grotesque Guardians
travel: Slayer Tower roof. Requires 75 Slayer, a brittle key, and Priest in Peril.
Fairy ring CKS then north-west to the tower.
Counts as gargoyles.

locations.name: Thermonuclear smoke devil
travel: Smoke Devil Dungeon inner chamber. Requires 93 Slayer.
Fairy ring BKP, then south into the dungeon.

monsters.name: Aberrant spectres
monsters.weakness: Slash. Salve amulet (ei) is a large boost versus undead.
recommendedEquipment: Best-in-slot melee or a budget strength setup
Amulet of torture, glory, or strength
Fire cape, infernal cape, or obsidian cape
monsters.notes: Without face protection they drain combat stats. Catacombs is a popular burst/cannon hybrid.

monsters.name: Abyssal demons
monsters.weakness: Demonbane weapons (emberlight, arclight, darklight). Vulnerable to crush.
recommendedEquipment: Best-in-slot melee or a budget strength setup
Amulet of torture, glory, or strength
Fire cape, infernal cape, or obsidian cape
Pegasian? bring a ranging switch for Sire if needed
requirements: Priest in Peril or Fairytale II for some locations
monsters.notes: Catacombs offers prayer restoration on aggressive demons. Sire is a slower boss alternative.

monsters.name: Ankou
monsters.weakness: Salve amulet (ei). Crush works well.
recommendedEquipment: Best-in-slot melee or a budget strength setup
Amulet of torture, glory, or strength
Fire cape, infernal cape, or obsidian cape
monsters.notes: Stronghold Slayer Cave and Catacombs are safe cannon spots. Wilderness variants are for Krystilia.

monsters.name: Aquanites
monsters.weakness: Ranged and stab. Stay mobile if they use strong magic hits.
recommendedEquipment: Bow of Faerdhinen, twisted bow, or toxic blowpipe
Pegasian boots or blessed d'hide boots
monsters.notes: Unlock from Nieve/Duradel with reward points. Superior is the Elder Aquanite.

monsters.name: Araxytes
monsters.weakness: Crush. Light and crush weapons do well; consider a spider bonus if available.
recommendedEquipment: Best-in-slot melee or a budget strength setup
Amulet of torture, glory, or strength
Fire cape, infernal cape, or obsidian cape
monsters.notes: Araxxor is the boss alternative and is much slower. Bring antivenom.

monsters.name: Aviansie
monsters.weakness: Ranged. They fly, so you need ranged, magic, or a halberd.
requiredItems: Ranged, magic, or a halberd (they are flying)
recommendedEquipment: Bow of Faerdhinen, twisted bow, or toxic blowpipe
Pegasian boots or blessed d'hide boots
Armadyl, Zamorak, or other god items to stay unaggressive to factions
monsters.notes: Must be unlocked with Slayer reward points. Bring god items. Ecumenical keys help for Kree'arra.

monsters.name: Bandits
monsters.weakness: No special weakness. Easy melee food.
recommendedEquipment: Best-in-slot melee or a budget strength setup
Amulet of torture, glory, or strength
Fire cape, infernal cape, or obsidian cape
requirements: Priest in Peril is not required here; this is a Wilderness task
monsters.notes: Krystilia only. Stay in the Wilderness Bandit Camp. Bring PvP protection.

monsters.name: Banshees
monsters.weakness: Salve amulet (ei), crush.
recommendedEquipment: Best-in-slot melee or a budget strength setup
Amulet of torture, glory, or strength
